shared_elements: low-relief carved surface with repeated motifs
patterned infill of a form (petal fans / fleece scales)
elements aligned along a register or band
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both are relief surfaces that use repeated, regularly patterned detail (radiating petal fans in A, rows of scale-like fleece marks in B) organised along a band. What is actually depicted is entirely different: A is a purely vegetal panel of stems, palmettes and flowers with no living figures, while B shows two horned rams in profile with human arms and legs driving or restraining them.
